Definition: probably from a derivative of the alternate of G4095 (compare G4224); a current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water:--flood, river, stream, water.
BiblicalUsage: Potamos is a river, a running stream, and it runs through both Testaments of imagery. John baptizes in Jordan, and Revelation shows a pure river of water of life proceeding out of the throne of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the river of life is where the whole story ends, and every other river in Scripture is only a picture of it.
